home.description: a session's default file-and-command target, not its permissions or the location of the agent; no home means no implicit local filesystem

cwd.description: an optional absolute command directory interpreted in the workspace filesystem; absent means workspace.root

workspace.description: the default workspace for subsequent calls; changing it leaves files and processes untouched

session_list.description: List every agent work-session record in the connected graph, as bundles: JSON objects with entity ids and their named groups of fields (components). Takes no arguments; includes sessions regardless of their status.
session_list.title: List sessions

session_new.title: Start a session here
session_new.description: Start an agent work session on this machine with an instruction, and run it until it settles. With --tui, an instruction is optional: an empty session opens in the terminal, ready for a message.

tui.description: open an empty session in the terminal

model.description: the model to ask, by name (otherwise the default: the using{provider, model} on the @yaks/harness package's row)

provider.description: the backend that serves it, by name: openai or openrouter (otherwise the default's)

persona.description: the persona to carry, by id or name (default: the oracle where a topic is given, else the checkout's persona)

topic.description: the topic to open it on, by id: the topic tree compiled from it (topic_read) follows the persona's text

cwd.description: Command directory in the selected workspace filesystem.

work.description: the graph task or project whose common persona to admit, independent of the machine checkout

session_send.title: Say more to a session here
session_send.description: Add an instruction to an agent work session and run it on this machine until it settles. Returns the session; under `--tui` the terminal holds it as the harness.

session.description: the session; pass its id or registered name

model.description: the model to ask, by name (otherwise the default: the using{provider, model} on the @yaks/harness package's row)

provider.description: the backend that serves it, by name: openai or openrouter (otherwise the default's)

model_list.title: List the models this machine can reach
model_list.description: List the models offered by this harness's OpenAI credential (OPENAI_API_KEY, else the OpenAI connection). The credential itself is never shown.

conversation_projects.description: Identify the trusted human caller and list active projects.

conversation_start.description: Start a native project conversation without waiting for a reply.

project.description: The active project to talk with.

conversation_send.description: Send exact human words to an owned project conversation without waiting.

project.description: The active project to talk with.

conversation_read.description: Read a bounded current transcript page, including progressive assistant replies. Poll again to receive revisions to the same message id.

project.description: The active project to talk with.

before.description: Read older entries strictly before this entry sequence. Omit to poll the current tail.

conversation_recent.description: List this caller’s recent project conversations.

project.description: The active project to talk with.

conversation_inbox.description: Read the trusted human caller’s inbox, using shared inbox policy.

session_home.description: Change a session default workspace without moving files, commands or permissions. Omitting cwd clears the previous directory.

cwd.description: Absolute command directory in the workspace filesystem.
